text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with Tanino Gimlet,
an old newspaper came flying out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "—'Abstract Painting on Display Revealed to Be a Fake'?! What is this...?! Isn't this the museum I visited with you the other day?!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "According to the museum, the acquisition route is clear, and it is hard to imagine it being a fake from the beginning..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Details currently under investigation," "Widely seeking eyewitness reports of suspicious persons from visitors and local residents..." it says.
Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Does she mean, "Before I knew it, I had become
a fake"?
...Come to think of it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For some reason, that painting was hanging 'upside down' that day.
The staff said it was probably just someone's prank, but..."
choice_data_list: Could it be, even back then... !?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that 'it was swapped with a fake'?
The culprit might have been in a rush when hanging the fake on the wall, and hung it upside down...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—I've got it! So that's what it meant!
Trainer! Let's head to the art museum right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't say I was brilliant like a great detective... but I do remember what time the painting was upside down. It should be somewhat useful testimony. ...However!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Staff member over there, gather everyone.
The mystery is solved!

text_block_list.name: Museum Staff
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Don't tell me this is about the swap incident!?
Just who are you...? Anyway, please come inside...

text_block_list.name: Museum Director
text_block_list.text:
――Is it true that you've solved the mystery of the incident?
We here at the inn are truly grasping at straws...
Please, do tell us.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh... Well then, shall we begin our deduction at once!
choice_data_list: (This has turned into a huge deal!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Assuming we had reached the same conclusion,
I rushed here without comparing notes, but...
Just what kind of deduction did she make...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Why was that painting upside down...?
Was the culprit in a hurry...? No!
Or did they simply not know which way was up...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Nay...! If they prepared a forgery, they must be intimately familiar with that painting. Meaning! They were in a situation where they 'could not hang it facing the right way'!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Next, the reason why "the suspicious person still hasn't been found"...
Let's think of it in reverse: "there never was such a person!"
In other words—!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The culprit "pulled a trick
and swapped the painting without ever entering the mansion"!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The tiny scratches on the frame of that abstract painting...
They must be 'marks left by tied wire.'
The culprit carried out the crime through the ceiling ventilation fan!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The painting suspended by wires spins around and around.
Yet, even if it hangs upside down, no one would notice right away.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The advantage of remaining unseen far outweighs the risks!
Carrying the real item swapped in secret, the culprit made a clean getaway through the ventilation fan!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and check inside the air ducts!!
The culprit will be obvious from the traces left behind!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The mystery has at last been dragged out of the box of chaos!!
BWAHAHAHAHAHA—!!

text_block_list.name: Museum Director
text_block_list.text:
I... I see...!?
That kind of trick was a total blind spot...!
Though there are still many things I don't quite understand...
choice_data_list: Still, we should at least be able to narrow down the “time of the crime”...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's just as this one says.
Our current deduction is merely "exploring possibilities."
However, time alone can be called an indisputable truth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Either way, what we saw should serve as a lead...! We explained this to the director.

text_block_list.name: Museum Director
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Alright! Let's report the date and time
the painting was upside down to the police and have them reinvestigate!
That should lead to some progress...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That sounds good.
From here on out, it's a job for the police.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... A detective does not waste legwork.
Intellectual labor is all I do...!
I'll leave the gathering of evidence to you.

text_block_list.name: Museum Staff
text_block_list.text: How can you be so utterly shameless about it...?! But at this point, it's almost cool...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That was quite an exhilarating time.
With this, the incident should be drawing to a close.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to stay involved until the end. A detective simply departs.
I trust the passion of the police and the museum staff,
and I have no hesitation in leaving the rest to them.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Above all else... I have to save
my legs for the race.
choice_data_list: As expected of the great detective.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh...! It seems you, too, have been intoxicated by my brilliant deductions...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuhaha...! That moment of inspiration! That electric shock!
Now this is a banquet of exploding brain cells!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Brilliant deduction or wild rambling...?
Her sheer intensity seems to solve cases beyond all reason...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, I had the help of an excellent Watson.
Should we encounter another case, you'd do well to follow me just like this time.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall intoxicate you with my brilliant deductions...!
Again and again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the case files of Detective Tanino Gimlet
were brought to a cool, stylish conclusion!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Kuhaha!
I was supposed to spend a peaceful day with you,
yet I've gotten dragged into quite the incident.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's stop by our usual bar for another drink.
We can raise a fine glass to the case, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, detective and assistant headed to the bar.
The mocktail after a job well done
tasted exceptionally exquisite...
